pages.title: Super Mario Toad Driving a Kart with a Shell Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad drives a kart while holding a shell in this Super Mario printable coloring page, smiling as he lifts the large segmented shell above the steering wheel. His spotted cap fills the upper scene, while the kart's exposed frame, thick tires, front bumper, and rear exhaust appear beneath scattered clouds.

pages.title: Super Mario Propeller Toad Flying Coloring Page
pages.description: Propeller Toad flies through the sky in this Super Mario printable coloring page, spreading both arms beneath the large two-bladed propeller mounted above his spotted cap. His small vest and rounded shoes tilt with his airborne body, above a tall mushroom and soft cloud outlines.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Playing Golf Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad plays golf in this Super Mario printable coloring page, gripping a club with both hands and raising it behind his large spotted cap before a swing. A dimpled ball rests on a tee near his shoes, with a flag-marked hole, low hills, and a small tree beyond him.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Running From a Goomba Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad runs from a Goomba in this Super Mario printable coloring page, opening his mouth in alarm as he throws both hands outward during the chase. The Goomba follows with raised brows and pointed fangs, while bent legs, curved motion marks, and dust puffs show their movement.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Standing and Smiling Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad stands and smiles in this Super Mario printable coloring page, lifting one open hand beside the wide spotted cap that fills the upper half of the portrait. His outlined vest, rounded trousers, oval shoes, and lowered free hand sit above a curved ground line with two grass tufts.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad and Toadette Holding Hands Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad and Toadette hold hands in this Super Mario printable coloring page, standing side by side beneath their large spotted caps with matching open-mouthed smiles. Toadette's segmented pigtails and short dress distinguish her from Toad's rounded trousers, with low bushes and simple clouds behind the pair.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad with Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad stands with Yoshi in this Super Mario printable coloring page, smiling and raising one hand beside the dinosaur's large rounded snout in a simple paired portrait. Toad's spotted cap and open vest contrast with Yoshi's tall eyes, back spikes, small saddle, tail, and broad cuffed shoes.

pages.title: Captain Toad Floating in Space Coloring Page
pages.description: Captain Toad floats in space in this printable coloring page, carrying a pickaxe while his free arm reaches outward beside a large backpack and rolled bedroll. A round headlamp rests over his spotted cap, with a ringed planet, a cratered rock, stars, and pointed sparkles around his dangling shoes.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Waving Happily Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad waves happily in this Super Mario printable coloring page, smiling broadly and lifting one hand beside his cheek beneath a large cap with round spots. His open vest and rounded shoes stand out against small clouds, a distant spotted mushroom, and a simple horizontal ground line.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad with Mario Peach and Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad joins Mario, Peach, and Yoshi in this Super Mario printable coloring page, standing at the edge of a group portrait near a distant turreted castle. Peach folds her hands over her gown beside Mario's cap and overalls, while Yoshi's rounded snout rises above scattered flowers and grass.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad with a Super Mushroom Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad holds a Super Mushroom in this Super Mario printable coloring page, smiling behind its spotted cap while supporting it with both hands at chest height. The mushroom has small oval eyes and a smile, with Toad's vest, rounded shoes, a cloud, and tall hills completing the scene.

pages.title: Super Mario Galaxy Movie Toad with Yoshi and Luigi Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad poses with Yoshi and Luigi in this Super Mario Galaxy Movie printable coloring page, waving from the front of the group beneath scattered outlined stars. Yoshi's tall eyes and broad snout rise beside Luigi's L cap and raised thumb, with all three characters shown from head to foot.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Driving a Go-kart Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad drives a go-kart in this Super Mario printable coloring page, sitting low in the seat and holding the steering wheel with both hands beneath his spotted cap. Thick tires, a tubular bumper, and the exposed steering column fill the foreground as the road curves behind him under clouds.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Jumping High Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad jumps high in this Super Mario printable coloring page, lifting both open hands beside his smiling face while one large shoe kicks forward beneath his rounded trousers. Long upward motion lines rise below his other foot, with small clouds and part of a rounded hill in the background.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Playing Soccer Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad plays soccer in this Super Mario printable coloring page, running toward a paneled ball with his arms spread and one cleated shoe reaching forward to kick. His short-sleeved jersey has a mushroom emblem and a side number, with a small goal and grass tufts across the field.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Riding Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad rides Yoshi in this Super Mario printable coloring page, sitting on the dinosaur's saddle and holding the reins as Yoshi steps forward with a broad smile. Their spotted cap, rounded snout, tail, and large shoes fill the coloring sheet above grass tufts and an oval ground mark.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad with a Mega Mushroom Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad holds a Mega Mushroom in this Super Mario printable coloring page, smiling as he supports its broad spotted cap and thick stem with both hands. A small backpack peeks behind his open vest, while his own large mushroom cap and rounded shoes frame the simple portrait.

pages.title: Captain Toad with His Backpack Coloring Page
pages.description: Captain Toad stands with his backpack in this printable coloring page, gripping both shoulder straps beneath the large round headlamp fastened over his spotted mushroom cap. His scarf, belt, pocketed shirt, and rounded shoes appear beside a side pouch containing tools, with rocks and a tall mushroom nearby.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad with Princess Peach Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad stands with Princess Peach in this Super Mario printable coloring page, smiling beside her puffed sleeve as she folds her hands at the front of her gown. Peach's crown, round earrings, and oval brooch rise above Toad's spotted cap and vest, backed by simple hills and a cloud.

pages.title: Super Mario Yellow Toad Smiling Coloring Page
pages.description: Yellow Toad smiles in this Super Mario printable coloring page, facing forward with both open hands extended beside the outlined edges of his short, open vest. A broad spotted mushroom cap dominates the portrait above his oval eyes and wide mouth, with rounded trousers and shoes below.

pages.title: Captain Toad with Toadette Coloring Page
pages.description: Captain Toad stands with Toadette in this printable coloring page, smiling beside her while wearing a headlamp, neckerchief, belt, and a backpack with a rolled bedroll. Toadette's segmented pigtails flank her short dress, and small mushrooms and a closed treasure chest surround the pair on a low hill.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Standing on Brick Blocks Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad stands on brick blocks in this Super Mario printable coloring page, holding both hands slightly outward beneath his large spotted cap and small smiling face. A tied neckerchief sits above the open edges of his vest, with two stepped rows of brick blocks supporting his rounded shoes.

pages.title: Super Mario Cat Toad Jumping Coloring Page
pages.description: Cat Toad jumps through the air in this Super Mario printable coloring page, lifting both paw gloves and kicking one oversized paw-shaped foot toward the viewer. Pointed ears rise above his spotted hood, with a bell at his neck, a curved tail, and a dotted jump path below.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Holding a Super Star Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad holds a Super Star in this Super Mario printable coloring page, supporting its lower points with both hands while smiling beneath his large spotted mushroom cap. Small oval eyes, short radiating lines, and two pointed sparkles distinguish the star beside Toad's open vest and rounded shoes.

pages.title: Super Mario Fire Toad Throwing Fireballs Coloring Page
pages.description: Fire Toad throws fireballs in this Super Mario printable coloring page, spreading both hands beside his spotted cap as two flaming spheres fly away from him. Angled speed lines trail behind the flames, and his slanted brows, open mouth, spread stance, and irregular ground shadow emphasize the action.

pages.title: Captain Toad Holding a Treasure Map Coloring Page
pages.description: Captain Toad holds a treasure map in this printable coloring page, spreading its ragged edges between both hands beneath his round headlamp and spotted mushroom cap. A dashed route, compass rose, mountains, island outline, and large X cover the map in front of his backpack, bedroll, and pickaxe.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Running with Coins Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad runs with coins in this Super Mario printable coloring page, pumping his bent arms and stretching one rounded shoe forward beneath his open vest and spotted cap. Four floating coins surround him, including one marked with a question mark, above a simple curved ground line.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Giving Flowers to Princess Peach Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad gives flowers to Princess Peach in this Super Mario printable coloring page, offering a tall bouquet while she reaches forward with both hands to receive it. Round-petaled blooms and pointed leaves fill the space between his spotted cap and her crown, puffed sleeves, brooch, and full gown.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Winning a Mario Kart Race Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad wins a Mario Kart race in this Super Mario printable coloring page, raising a trophy and a checkered flag while sitting in his small racing kart. A wide finish ribbon crosses the front of the vehicle, with stars, pointed sparkles, and the curving track behind his spotted cap.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Kicking a Shell at Luigi Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad kicks a shell at Luigi in this Super Mario printable coloring page, balancing on one foot as the segmented shell flies toward Luigi's startled face. Luigi turns with both gloved hands open, while speed lines, Toad's patterned vest, and small grass tufts complete the sparse action scene.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad with Baby Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad stands with Baby Yoshi in this Super Mario printable coloring page, waving beside the seated dinosaur while both characters smile within a decorative corner-cut border. Baby Yoshi's large snout, head spikes, small saddle, tail, and forward-facing shoes rest beside a winding path, stones, and grass tufts.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Guarding Peach's Castle Gates Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad guards Peach's castle gates in this Super Mario printable coloring page, holding a tall spear and a mushroom-emblem shield on the paved entrance path. Closed arched doors, a star crest, flag-topped towers, and patterned stonework fill the castle wall behind him, with shrubs and flowers along the edges.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Racing in Mario Kart Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad races in Mario Kart in this Super Mario printable coloring page, leaning toward the steering wheel with a wide smile beneath his oversized spotted mushroom cap. The kart's tubular bumper, exposed steering shaft, and broad tires sit low on the curving track beside a lone rounded tree.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad with Mario Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad stands with Mario in this Super Mario printable coloring page, smiling at his side while Mario lifts a large gloved hand in a wave. Their spotted mushroom cap and M cap rise above open vest panels and buttoned overalls, with bushes, a cloud, and a floating mushroom behind them.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Cheering for Mario Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad cheers for Mario in this Super Mario printable coloring page, raising both hands beside his smiling face as Mario stands close behind him in cap and overalls. Long rounded hills and low shrubs form the landscape, with three simple clouds above the pair's large shoes and bright expressions.

pages.title: Super Mario Tanooki Toad Gliding Coloring Page
pages.description: Tanooki Toad glides through the sky in this Super Mario printable coloring page, spreading both arms while his striped tail extends behind his rounded, airborne body. Animal ears rise above the spots on his mushroom cap, and triangular gliding panels stretch beneath his arms between the surrounding clouds.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Holding a Trophy Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad holds a trophy in this Super Mario printable coloring page, lifting the large cup above his head with one hand at its stem and one beneath its base. The trophy's high curved handles overlap his spotted cap, while his smiling face, open vest, and rounded shoes appear below.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad in Mario Kart Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad sits in a Mario Kart in this Super Mario printable coloring page, holding the wheel in both hands and smiling beneath his wide spotted mushroom cap. A curving course and rounded bushes appear behind the kart's rear exhaust, exposed frame, broad front bumper, and thick smooth tires.

pages.title: Captain Toad with a Pickaxe Coloring Page
pages.description: Captain Toad carries a pickaxe in this printable coloring page, holding its handle across his body while smiling beneath the oversized headlamp strapped to his spotted mushroom cap. The curved tool head reaches toward his shoes, with backpack straps, a rolled bedroll, scarf, belt, and shirt pockets behind it.

pages.title: Super Mario Squirrel Toad Flying Coloring Page
pages.description: Squirrel Toad flies through the sky in this Super Mario printable coloring page, stretching both arms outward so broad gliding panels spread beside his oval belly patch. A long curved tail and pointed ears distinguish his suit, while spots remain visible on his cap between the surrounding cloud outlines.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Swimming with Cheep Cheeps Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad swims with Cheep Cheeps in this Super Mario printable coloring page, extending his arms while long flippers trail behind his legs beneath a spotted mushroom cap. Three round fish, rising bubbles, and wavy current lines surround him above clusters of rocks and tall seaweed fronds.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Hitting a Dice Block Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad hits a dice block in this Super Mario printable coloring page, jumping with one hand raised toward the large floating cube beside his spotted mushroom cap. Question marks cover the block's two visible faces, while his open vest, bent legs, and oval ground shadow complete the uncluttered scene.

pages.title: Super Mario Blue Toad Waving Coloring Page
pages.description: Blue Toad waves in this Super Mario printable coloring page, raising one open hand above his shoulder and smiling beneath the large spots of his mushroom cap. A triangular neckerchief lies over his open vest, with the other hand lowered beside rounded trousers and two broad oval shoes.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad with Mario Luigi and Princess Peach Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad poses with Mario, Luigi, and Princess Peach in this Super Mario printable coloring page, standing at the front of a tightly arranged group portrait against an open background. Mario and Luigi flank his spotted cap in lettered hats and overalls, while crowned Peach folds her hands behind them.

pages.title: Captain Toad Finding a Power Star Coloring Page
pages.description: Captain Toad finds a Power Star in this printable coloring page, holding its large five-pointed shape between both hands while smiling beneath his headlamp and spotted cap. The star's tall oval eyes face forward beside his backpack and bedroll, surrounded by cave walls, small stones, and sparse plants.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Running with a Red Shell Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad runs with a red shell in this Super Mario printable coloring page, carrying it on an open palm while stretching his free arm behind his smiling figure. The shell's segmented top and curved rim sit beside his spotted cap, with one shoe thrust forward above horizontal ground marks.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad with Mario and Luigi Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad stands with Mario and Luigi in this Super Mario printable coloring page, smiling beside the two brothers in a full-length portrait with a plain background. Luigi's L cap rises at one side of Mario's M cap, while gloves, buttoned overalls, Toad's vest, and rounded shoes complete the trio.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Playing Tennis Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad plays tennis in this Super Mario printable coloring page, holding a racket with both hands as a ball travels beside his spotted cap above the net. He wears a collared shirt, shorts, and laced sports shoes, with court markings, distant trees, and small clouds behind him.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad Outside a Mushroom House Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad stands outside a mushroom house in this Super Mario printable coloring page, waving beside its arched plank door beneath a broad roof patterned with large round spots. His small backpack and open vest appear above rounded shoes, with a cross-paned window, grass, flowers, hills, and clouds around the house.

pages.title: Super Mario Toad in the Mushroom Kingdom Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad smiles in the Mushroom Kingdom village in this Super Mario printable coloring page, holding both hands near the front of his vest beneath his oversized spotted cap. A smiling mushroom house and two smaller homes occupy the rolling landscape, with a winding path, tall rounded hills, and clouds behind him.

pages.title: Mario Toad Waving in Snow Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad waves in the Snow Kingdom in this Mario printable coloring page, smiling in a zip-front jacket and boots beneath his large spotted mushroom cap. Snowflakes and round flakes fall around snow-covered trees, banded mountains, and a mushroom house beside a winding path through the drifts.

pages.title: Mario Toad Walking in Underground Tunnel Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad walks through an underground tunnel in this Mario printable coloring page, carrying a loaded backpack beneath a star-emblem headlamp strapped across his spotted mushroom cap. Rope, a rolled bedroll, and a pickaxe hang behind his pocketed shirt, with boots, spotted shorts, rocks, and cave mushrooms along the passage.

pages.title: Mario Toad Running in Pyramid Area Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad runs through a pyramid area with Mario in this printable coloring page, following behind him along a curving path bordered by scattered blocks and stones. Three large pyramids rise beyond the pair's pumping arms, with palm trees and low clouds above Toad's spotted cap and Mario's M cap.

pages.title: Mario Toad Exploring in Underground Tunnel Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad explores an underground tunnel in this Mario printable coloring page, stepping along a narrow rocky ledge with both arms held outward beneath his spotted mushroom cap. Layered cave walls and hanging stalactites curve around the passage, with a pointed rock formation and small loose stones on the ledge.

pages.title: Mario Toad Jumping in Sky Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad jumps in the Sky Kingdom with Mario in this printable coloring page, spreading his hands while Mario lifts a gloved fist beside his lettered cap. Overlapping cloud banks fill the space beneath their raised shoes, with scattered stars and a small castle resting on a cloud behind them.

pages.title: Mario Toad Watching In Underground Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad watches inside an underground cave in this Mario printable coloring page, looking upward with a small round mouth beneath the broad spots of his mushroom cap. Floating oval rings and tiny circles surround his head, while stalactites, angular cave walls, loose stones, and boots complete the rocky scene.

pages.title: Mario Toad Waving By River Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad waves by a river in this Mario printable coloring page, lifting one hand and smiling while standing near rounded stones along the winding water's edge. Three clouds float above distant hills, and simple current lines follow the river's bends beside his open vest and spotted mushroom cap.

pages.title: Mario Toad Observing In Start Area Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad observes a start area in this Mario printable coloring page, standing with a downturned mouth beside a large checkered flag and a short open pipe. Two small mushrooms peek above the distant ground line, with rounded hills, low bushes, and a cloud behind his spotted cap and vest.

pages.title: Mario Toad Watching In Wheat Field Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad watches from a wheat field in this Mario printable coloring page, looking upward with a smile as tall grain heads surround his spotted cap and open vest. Long pointed leaves cross the foreground around his boots, while smaller wheat stalks, rounded hills, and broad cloud shapes continue behind him.

pages.title: Mario Toad Reaching On Hill Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad reaches upward on a hill in this Mario printable coloring page, raising one hand above his smiling face while the other rests beside his open vest. Angular rocks and a spotted mushroom sit around his boots, with circular sun shapes and simple rays above the rounded hilltop.

pages.title: Mario Toad Watching In Treasure Room Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad watches in a treasure room in this Mario printable coloring page, standing with wide eyes and a round mouth between two open chests overflowing with faceted gems. Tall coin stacks, loose question-mark coins, and treasure piles crowd the floor beneath arched doors, a round window, and exposed wall blocks.

pages.title: Mario Toad Watching In Jungle Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad watches in a jungle in this Mario printable coloring page, looking upward with a small open mouth while standing on a path beneath leafy vines. A bent palm trunk, broad pointed leaves, rounded bushes, and an angular rock surround his spotted mushroom cap, open vest, and small boots.

pages.title: Mario Toad Thinking In Bonus Room Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad thinks in a bonus room in this Mario printable coloring page, sitting on a question block with one hand against his chin beneath a question-mark thought bubble. Brick cubes, floating blocks, and a coin surround him, while a grid of square floor tiles adds straight lines below his rounded shoes.

pages.title: Mario Toad Exploring In Desert Level Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad explores a desert level in this Mario printable coloring page, carrying a pickaxe over one shoulder while smiling beneath his large spotted mushroom cap. Ribbed cacti, scattered stones, blocky canyon walls, and a distant stepped pyramid fill the coloring sheet under clouds and a sun with pointed rays.

pages.title: Mario Toad Walking On Beach Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad walks on a beach in this Mario printable coloring page, carrying a small bucket and shovel as he steps along the sand beside the water. A large ridged shell lies near his forward shoe, with palm trees, low waves, two clouds, and a round sun behind his spotted cap.

pages.title: Mario Toad Balancing In Block Field Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad balances in a block field in this Mario printable coloring page, standing on one foot atop a plain cube with both arms stretched wide and one knee raised. Question blocks and brick-patterned cubes form the pile beneath him, with wavy-banded mountains and simple clouds along the horizon.

pages.title: Mario Toad Jumping In Finish Area Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad jumps in a finish area in this Mario printable coloring page, spreading both arms above a winner's podium beneath a large curved sign reading Finish. Confetti falls around his raised shoes, with an oversized checkered flag, a small turreted castle, and rounded clouds behind the celebration.

pages.title: Mario Toad Watching On Bridge Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad watches from a bridge in this Mario printable coloring page, standing at its crest and smiling above the arch that spans a gently curving river. Brick outlines and large arch stones define the bridge, surrounded by spotted mushrooms, rolling hills, riverbank stones, grass tufts, clouds, and a pointed sun.

pages.title: Mario Toad Posing Proudly In A Snowy Level Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad poses proudly in a snowy level in this Mario printable coloring page, resting both hands on his hips and smiling beneath his large spotted mushroom cap. Two ice blocks sit beside his boots on a snow-covered ledge, with smooth drifts and a single pointed evergreen behind him.

pages.title: Mario Toad Standing Proudly In A Sky Level Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad stands proudly in a sky level in this Mario printable coloring page, folding his arms across his open vest while smiling beneath a large spotted mushroom cap. Scalloped floating platforms and outlined stars surround him, with rounded and spiral-patterned clouds clustered around the simple ground line.

pages.title: Mario Toad Celebrating Happily In A Desert Level Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad celebrates happily in a desert level in this Mario printable coloring page, raising both hands and one foot beneath the broad spots of his mushroom cap. A tall ribbed cactus, angular boulders, winding ground contours, and distant banded mountains surround him below a large sun with pointed rays.

pages.title: Mario Toad Waving Happily In A Beach Level Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad waves happily in a beach level in this Mario printable coloring page, lifting both open hands beside his smiling face while standing near the curved shoreline. Palm trees lean above low bushes, small wave marks cross the water, and a large sun sends long straight rays into the sky.

pages.title: Mario Toad Standing Proudly In A Grassy Level Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad stands proudly in a grassy level in this Mario printable coloring page, keeping both hands on his hips beneath an oversized spotted cap and wide smile. Grass tufts cover the rounded platform at his feet, with a scalloped front edge, low distant hills, and two small clouds.

pages.title: Mario Toad Looking Happy In A Colorful World Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad looks happy in a colorful world in this Mario printable coloring page, stretching his arms outward while standing among spotted mushrooms and tall rounded hills. His open vest and broad boots fill the center of the coloring sheet, framed by low bushes and small grass shapes.

pages.title: Mario Toad Looking Surprised In A Fantasy Land Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad looks surprised in a fantasy land in this Mario printable coloring page, opening his mouth wide beneath his spotted cap while standing beside a curving path. Spiral-branched trees and rounded bushes frame a distant flag-topped castle, with banded hills and small grass tufts filling the landscape.

pages.title: Mario Toad Smiling Happily In A Sky Level Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad smiles happily in a sky level in this Mario printable coloring page, lifting one open hand as his rounded shoes rise between soft cloud outlines. A broad rainbow arches behind his spotted cap, and layered cloud edges surround his open vest, extended free arm, and bent legs.

pages.title: Mario Toad Getting Ready To Explore In A Bright Adventure Land Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad gets ready to explore a bright adventure land in this Mario printable coloring page, holding a rolled map and a compass beneath a small feathered cap. His backpack, belt, and boots appear within a square scene of giant spotted mushrooms, spiral trees, distant mountains, and winding paths under the sun.

pages.title: Mario Toad Waving Happily In A Colorful World Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad waves happily in a colorful world in this Mario printable coloring page, holding both hands high beside his smiling face and large spotted mushroom cap. Two tall flowers with spiral centers flank his vest and boots, with rounded hills, bushes, and soft clouds behind the pair of blooms.

pages.title: Mario Toad Posing Proudly In A Colorful World Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad poses proudly in a colorful world in this Mario printable coloring page, standing with both hands on his hips atop the wide rim of a short pipe. Large flowers and pointed leaves frame his boots, while low bushes, spotted rounded hills, and clouds rise behind his mushroom cap.

pages.title: Mario Toad Walking Happily In A Bright Adventure Land Coloring Page
pages.description: Toad walks happily through a bright adventure land in this Mario printable coloring page, stepping forward with both arms spread and a broad smile beneath his spotted cap. A winding path leads between low bushes, rounded hills with wavy bands, and tall spotted mushrooms under a pair of clouds.
